title: For each subject offered in the academic term with term code '2006FA', and
question: For each subject offered in the academic term with term code '2006FA', and for each department and course number where the number of enrolled students in the subject summary is greater than 2, show the subject ID, subject title, department name, the sum of lecture units within each grade type group, the offer department name, the course number, the number of unique library subjects offered, the minimum total units for those subjects, and for each offer department and course number, include a grand total for all subjects in the format of (null, null, null, null, offer department name, course number, total subject count, minimum total units). Do not return any rounded answers.

historical_programs.sql_template: WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.LECTURE_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column, t1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t0 JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2006FA') SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column, t1.TERM_CODE FROM `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS t1 INNER JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE INNER JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 1) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.window_column, t3.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t3.TERM_START_DATE FROM inner_cte INNER JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t3 ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = t3.TERM_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column AS sum_lecture_units_by_grade_type, s1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.window_column AS subject_rank_within_academic_year, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.TERM_START_DATE FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID AND s1.SUBJECT_TITLE = s2.SUBJECT_TITLE AND s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.SUBJECT_ID

WITH math_courses AS (SELECT t0.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.COURSE_NUMBER) AS window_column, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_CODE FROM `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5), subjects_2014fa AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY sos.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.TERM_CODE FROM `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS lso JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0) SELECT mc.COURSE_NUMBER, mc.SUBJECT_TITLE, mc.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, mc.TERM_DESCRIPTION, mc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mc.window_column AS math_window_column, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subj2014fa_SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s2.TOTAL_UNITS, s2.window_column AS subj2014fa_window_column FROM math_courses AS mc JOIN subjects_2014fa AS s2 ON mc.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID AND mc.TERM_CODE = s2.TERM_CODE

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    cco.SUBJECT_ID,
    cco.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    cco.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    cco.GRADE_TYPE,
    cco.LECTURE_UNITS,
    cco.TOTAL_UNITS,
    sso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
    sso.COURSE_NUMBER
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cco
  JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at
    ON at.TERM_CODE = cco.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE
  JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sso
    ON sso.SUBJECT_ID = cco.SUBJECT_ID
   AND sso.TERM_CODE = cco.TERM_CODE
  JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss
    ON ss.SUBJECT_ID = cco.SUBJECT_ID
   AND ss.TERM_CODE = cco.TERM_CODE
  WHERE at.TERM_CODE = '2006FA'
    AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 2
),
lib AS (
  SELECT
    b.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
    b.COURSE_NUMBER,
    b.SUBJECT_ID,
    COUNT(DISTINCT lso.SUBJECT_ID) AS lib_count,
    MIN(b.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_units
  FROM base b
  LEFT JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso
    ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = b.SUBJECT_ID
   AND lso.TERM_CODE = '2006FA'
  GROUP BY b.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, b.COURSE_NUMBER, b.SUBJECT_ID
),
detail AS (
  SELECT
    b.SUBJECT_ID,
    b.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    b.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    SUM(b.LECTURE_UNITS) AS sum_lecture_units,
    b.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
    b.COURSE_NUMBER,
    MAX(l.lib_count) AS lib_count,
    MIN(b.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_units
  FROM base b
  JOIN lib l
    ON l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = b.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
   AND l.COURSE_NUMBER = b.COURSE_NUMBER
   AND l.SUBJECT_ID = b.SUBJECT_ID
  GROUP BY b.SUBJECT_ID, b.SUBJECT_TITLE, b.DEPARTMENT_NAME, b.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, b.COURSE_NUMBER
),
grand AS (
  SELECT
    NULL AS SUBJECT_ID,
    NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE,
    NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    NULL AS sum_lecture_units,
    OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
    COURSE_NUMBER,
    COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS lib_count,
    MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_units
  FROM base
  GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COURSE_NUMBER
)
SELECT * FROM detail
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM grand
